description: This PHP source file defines the NodeSys class in the Goteo package, providing static methods to manage and retrieve data related to nodes, such as validation, activation status, list of active nodes, and node data fetching. It interacts with database models and external classes like Image and Config.

classes.name: NodeSys
classes.description: Provides static methods for node validation, status checking, listing active nodes, and retrieving node-specific data within the Goteo system.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if a node with the given ID exists in the database.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Checks if a node with the given ID is active and not a test node.

methods.name: activeNodes
methods.description: Returns a list of active nodes excluding the current node, the test node, and nodes without URLs.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Retrieves detailed data of a node, including name, URL, subtitle, description, and logo, with logo processed through the Image class.
